input.text:
2024 BMO Round 1 第5题。题目：p 是素数，n 是满足 n>1 且 p | (n^6−1) 的最小正整数。证明 p | ((n+1)^6−1) 或 p | ((n+2)^6−1)。

证明：
由恒等式 t^6−1=(t−1)(t+1)(t²+t+1)(t²−t+1)，以及 p 为素数且 p|(n^6−1)，p 必整除这四个因子中的至少一个。逐一讨论。
情形一，p|(n²+n+1)。则模 p 有 n+1≡−n²，所以 (n+1)^6≡n^12≡(n^6)^2≡1。因此 p|((n+1)^6−1)。
情形二，p|(n+1)。则 n+2≡1 (mod p)，所以 (n+2)^6≡1，故 p|((n+2)^6−1)。
情形三，p|(n−1)。则 n≡1 (mod p)，故 n−2≡−1 (mod p)，从而 (n−2)^6≡1 (mod p)。若 n≥4，则 n−2>1 且 n−2<n，这与 n 的最小性矛盾。因此此情形只能有 n=2 或 n=3；但 n=2 时 p|1 不可能，故 n=3。此时 p|(n−1)=2，故 p=2；而 (n+2)^6−1=5^6−1 为偶数，结论成立。
情形四，p|(n²−n+1)。则 n−1≡n² (mod p)，因此 (n−1)^6≡n^12≡1 (mod p)。若 n≥3，则 1<n−1<n，违反最小性，所以 n=2。此时 p|(2²−2+1)=3，即 p=3，且 (n+2)^6−1=4^6−1=4095 可被3整除。
以上四种情形穷尽所有可能，故断言成立。

  intro p hp n hn hdiv hmin
  letI : Fact p.Prime := ⟨hp⟩
  have hn1 : 1 ≤ n := by omega
  have hn0 : 0 < n := by omega
  have hpow1 : 1 ≤ n ^ 6 := by
    have hpos6 : 0 < n ^ 6 := pow_pos hn0 6
    omega
  have hx6 : (n : ZMod p) ^ 6 = 1 := by
    have hcast : ((n ^ 6 - 1 : ℕ) : ZMod p) = 0 := by
      rw [ZMod.natCast_eq_zero_iff_dvd]
      exact hdiv
    have hcast' : ((n : ZMod p) ^ 6 - 1) = 0 := by
      simpa [Nat.cast_sub hpow1, Nat.cast_pow] using hcast
    exact sub_eq_zero.mp hcast'
  have hnle_sq : n ≤ n ^ 2 := by
    have hn2 : 2 ≤ n := by omega
    nlinarith
  have hcast_nm1 : ((n - 1 : ℕ) : ZMod p) = (n : ZMod p) - 1 := by
    rw [Nat.cast_sub hn1]
    norm_num
  have hcast_n2mn1 : ((n ^ 2 - n + 1 : ℕ) : ZMod p) =
      (n : ZMod p) ^ 2 - (n : ZMod p) + 1 := by
    rw [Nat.cast_add, Nat.cast_sub hnle_sq, Nat.cast_pow, Nat.cast_one]
    ring
  have hprod :
      ((n : ZMod p) - 1) *
        (((n : ZMod p) + 1) *
          (((n : ZMod p) ^ 2 + (n : ZMod p) + 1) *
            ((n : ZMod p) ^ 2 - (n : ZMod p) + 1))) = 0 := by
    have hfac : ((n : ZMod p) ^ 6 - 1) =
        ((n : ZMod p) - 1) *
          (((n : ZMod p) + 1) *
            (((n : ZMod p) ^ 2 + (n : ZMod p) + 1) *
              ((n : ZMod p) ^ 2 - (n : ZMod p) + 1))) := by
      ring
    rw [← hfac, hx6]
    ring
  have hzero :
      ((n : ZMod p) - 1 = 0) ∨
      ((n : ZMod p) + 1 = 0) ∨
      ((n : ZMod p) ^ 2 + (n : ZMod p) + 1 = 0) ∨
      ((n : ZMod p) ^ 2 - (n : ZMod p) + 1 = 0) := by
    rcases mul_eq_zero.mp hprod with h1 | h234
    · exact Or.inl h1
    · rcases mul_eq_zero.mp h234 with h2 | h34
      · exact Or.inr (Or.inl h2)
      · rcases mul_eq_zero.mp h34 with h3 | h4
        · exact Or.inr (Or.inr (Or.inl h3))
        · exact Or.inr (Or.inr (Or.inr h4))
  have source_step_0 : p ∣ (n - 1) ∨ p ∣ (n + 1) ∨
      p ∣ (n ^ 2 + n + 1) ∨ p ∣ (n ^ 2 - n + 1) := by
    rcases hzero with h1 | h2 | h3 | h4
    · left
      rw [← ZMod.natCast_eq_zero_iff_dvd]
      rw [hcast_nm1]
      exact h1
    · right; left
      rw [← ZMod.natCast_eq_zero_iff_dvd]
      simpa using h2
    · right; right; left
      rw [← ZMod.natCast_eq_zero_iff_dvd]
      simpa [Nat.cast_add, Nat.cast_pow] using h3
    · right; right; right
      rw [← ZMod.natCast_eq_zero_iff_dvd]
      rw [hcast_n2mn1]
      exact h4
  have source_step_1 : p ∣ (n ^ 2 + n + 1) → p ∣ ((n + 1) ^ 6 - 1) := by
    intro hq
    have hqZ : ((n ^ 2 + n + 1 : ℕ) : ZMod p) = 0 := by
      rw [ZMod.natCast_eq_zero_iff_dvd]
      exact hq
    have hqZ' : (n : ZMod p) ^ 2 + (n : ZMod p) + 1 = 0 := by
      simpa [Nat.cast_add, Nat.cast_pow] using hqZ
    have hrel : (n : ZMod p) + 1 = -((n : ZMod p) ^ 2) := by
      linear_combination hqZ'
    have hpow : ((n : ZMod p) + 1) ^ 6 = 1 := by
      rw [hrel]
      have hneg : (-((n : ZMod p) ^ 2)) ^ 6 = ((n : ZMod p) ^ 6) ^ 2 := by
        ring
      rw [hneg, hx6]
      norm_num
    rw [← ZMod.natCast_eq_zero_iff_dvd]
    have hpos : 0 < n + 1 := by omega
    have hle : 1 ≤ (n + 1) ^ 6 := by
      have hpos6 : 0 < (n + 1) ^ 6 := pow_pos hpos 6
      omega
    rw [Nat.cast_sub hle]
    have hcastpow : (((n + 1) ^ 6 : ℕ) : ZMod p) = ((n : ZMod p) + 1) ^ 6 := by
      rw [Nat.cast_pow, Nat.cast_add]
      norm_num
    rw [hcastpow, hpow]
    norm_num
  have source_step_2 : p ∣ (n + 1) → p ∣ ((n + 2) ^ 6 - 1) := by
    intro hq
    have hqZ : ((n + 1 : ℕ) : ZMod p) = 0 := by
      rw [ZMod.natCast_eq_zero_iff_dvd]
      exact hq
    have hxplus : (n : ZMod p) + 1 = 0 := by
      simpa using hqZ
    have hx : (n : ZMod p) = -1 := by
      linear_combination hxplus
    have hpow : ((n + 2 : ℕ) : ZMod p) ^ 6 = 1 := by
      have hcast2 : ((n + 2 : ℕ) : ZMod p) = (n : ZMod p) + 2 := by
        rw [Nat.cast_add]
        norm_num
      rw [hcast2, hx]
      norm_num
    rw [← ZMod.natCast_eq_zero_iff_dvd]
    have hpos : 0 < n + 2 := by omega
    have hle : 1 ≤ (n + 2) ^ 6 := by
      have hpos6 : 0 < (n + 2) ^ 6 := pow_pos hpos 6
      omega
    rw [Nat.cast_sub hle]
    have hcastpow : (((n + 2) ^ 6 : ℕ) : ZMod p) = (((n + 2 : ℕ) : ZMod p) ^ 6) := by
      rw [Nat.cast_pow]
    rw [hcastpow, hpow]
    norm_num
  have source_step_3 : p ∣ (n - 1) → p ∣ ((n - 2) ^ 6 - 1) := by
    intro hcase
    by_cases hn_eq2 : n = 2
    · subst n
      have hp_dvd1 : p ∣ 1 := by simpa using hcase
      exfalso

      have hp_ge2 : 2 ≤ p := hp.two_le
      omega
    · have hn3 : 3 ≤ n := by omega
      have hx1 : (n : ZMod p) = 1 := by
        have hz : ((n - 1 : ℕ) : ZMod p) = 0 := by
          rw [ZMod.natCast_eq_zero_iff_dvd]
          exact hcase
        rw [hcast_nm1] at hz
        exact sub_eq_zero.mp hz
      have hpow : ((n - 2 : ℕ) : ZMod p) ^ 6 = 1 := by
        have hn2 : 2 ≤ n := by omega
        have hcast2 : ((n - 2 : ℕ) : ZMod p) = (n : ZMod p) - 2 := by
          rw [Nat.cast_sub hn2]
          norm_num
        rw [hcast2, hx1]
        norm_num
      rw [← ZMod.natCast_eq_zero_iff_dvd]
      have hpos : 0 < n - 2 := by omega
      have hle : 1 ≤ (n - 2) ^ 6 := by
        have hpos6 : 0 < (n - 2) ^ 6 := pow_pos hpos 6
        omega
      rw [Nat.cast_sub hle]
      have hcastpow : (((n - 2) ^ 6 : ℕ) : ZMod p) = (((n - 2 : ℕ) : ZMod p) ^ 6) := by
        rw [Nat.cast_pow]
      rw [hcastpow, hpow]
      norm_num
  have source_step_4 : p ∣ (n - 1) → ¬ 4 ≤ n := by
    intro hcase hn4
    have hdvd : p ∣ ((n - 2) ^ 6 - 1) := source_step_3 hcase
    have hm_gt : 1 < n - 2 := by omega
    have hm_lt : n - 2 < n := by omega
    exact hmin (n - 2) hm_gt hm_lt hdvd
  have source_step_5 : p ∣ (n - 1) → n = 3 := by
    intro hcase
    have hle3 : n ≤ 3 := by
      by_contra hle
      have hn4 : 4 ≤ n := by omega
      exact source_step_4 hcase hn4
    have hn23 : n = 2 ∨ n = 3 := by omega
    rcases hn23 with h2 | h3
    · subst n
      have hp_dvd1 : p ∣ 1 := by simpa using hcase
      exfalso
      have hp_le1 : p ≤ 1 := Nat.le_of_dvd (by norm_num : 0 < 1) hp_dvd1
      have hp_ge2 : 2 ≤ p := hp.two_le
      omega
    · exact h3
  have source_step_6 : p ∣ (n - 1) → p ∣ ((n + 2) ^ 6 - 1) := by
    intro hcase
    have hn3 : n = 3 := source_step_5 hcase
    rw [hn3] at hcase ⊢
    have hp_dvd2 : p ∣ 2 := by simpa using hcase
    have hp_le2 : p ≤ 2 := Nat.le_of_dvd (by norm_num : 0 < 2) hp_dvd2
    have hp_ge2 : 2 ≤ p := hp.two_le
    have hp_eq2 : p = 2 := by omega
    rw [hp_eq2]
    norm_num
  have source_step_7 : p ∣ (n ^ 2 - n + 1) → p ∣ ((n - 1) ^ 6 - 1) := by
    intro hcase
    have hqZ : ((n ^ 2 - n + 1 : ℕ) : ZMod p) = 0 := by
      rw [ZMod.natCast_eq_zero_iff_dvd]
      exact hcase
    have hqZ' : (n : ZMod p) ^ 2 - (n : ZMod p) + 1 = 0 := by
      rw [hcast_n2mn1] at hqZ
      exact hqZ
    have hrel : (n : ZMod p) - 1 = (n : ZMod p) ^ 2 := by
      linear_combination -hqZ'
    have hpow : ((n : ZMod p) - 1) ^ 6 = 1 := by
      rw [hrel]
      have hsqpow : (((n : ZMod p) ^ 2) ^ 6) = ((n : ZMod p) ^ 6) ^ 2 := by
        ring
      rw [hsqpow, hx6]
      norm_num
    rw [← ZMod.natCast_eq_zero_iff_dvd]
    have hpos : 0 < n - 1 := by omega
    have hle : 1 ≤ (n - 1) ^ 6 := by
      have hpos6 : 0 < (n - 1) ^ 6 := pow_pos hpos 6
      omega
    rw [Nat.cast_sub hle]
    have hcastpow : (((n - 1) ^ 6 : ℕ) : ZMod p) = ((n : ZMod p) - 1) ^ 6 := by
      rw [Nat.cast_pow]
      rw [hcast_nm1]
    rw [hcastpow, hpow]
    norm_num
  have source_step_8 : p ∣ (n ^ 2 - n + 1) → n = 2 := by
    intro hcase
    have hdvd : p ∣ ((n - 1) ^ 6 - 1) := source_step_7 hcase
    have hnot : ¬ 3 ≤ n := by
      intro hn3
      have hm_gt : 1 < n - 1 := by omega
      have hm_lt : n - 1 < n := by omega
      exact hmin (n - 1) hm_gt hm_lt hdvd
    have hn_ge2 : 2 ≤ n := by omega
    have hn_le2 : n ≤ 2 := by omega
    omega
  have source_step_9 : p ∣ (n ^ 2 - n + 1) → p ∣ ((n + 2) ^ 6 - 1) := by
    intro hcase
    have hn2 : n = 2 := source_step_8 hcase
    rw [hn2] at hcase ⊢
    have hp_dvd3 : p ∣ 3 := by
      norm_num at hcase
      exact hcase
    have hp_le3 : p ≤ 3 := Nat.le_of_dvd (by norm_num : 0 < 3) hp_dvd3
    have hp_ge2 : 2 ≤ p := hp.two_le
    have hp_eq3 : p = 3 := by
      have hp_cases : p = 2 ∨ p = 3 := by omega
      rcases hp_cases with hp2 | hp3
      · subst p
        exfalso
        have hnot : ¬ (2 ∣ 3) := by norm_num
        exact hnot hp_dvd3
      · exact hp3
    rw [hp_eq3]
    norm_num
  have source_step_10 :
      (p ∣ (n - 1) ∨ p ∣ (n + 1) ∨ p ∣ (n ^ 2 + n + 1) ∨ p ∣ (n ^ 2 - n + 1)) →
      (p ∣ ((n + 1) ^ 6 - 1) ∨ p ∣ ((n + 2) ^ 6 - 1)) := by
    intro hcases
    rcases hcases with h1 | h2 | h3 | h4
    · exact Or.inr (source_step_6 h1)
    · exact Or.inr (source_step_2 h2)
    · exact Or.inl (source_step_1 h3)
    · exact Or.inr (source_step_9 h4)
  exact source_step_10 source_step_0

2024 BMO Round 1 第5题。题目：p 是素数，n 是满足 n>1 且 p | (n^6−1) 的最小正整数。证明 p | ((n+1)^6−1) 或 p | ((n+2)^6−1)。

证明：
由恒等式 t^6−1=(t−1)(t+1)(t²+t+1)(t²−t+1)，以及 p 为素数且 p|(n^6−1)，p 必整除这四个因子中的至少一个。逐一讨论。
情形一，p|(n²+n+1)。则模 p 有 n+1≡−n²，所以 (n+1)^6≡n^12≡(n^6)^2≡1。因此 p|((n+1)^6−1)。
情形二，p|(n+1)。则 n+2≡1 (mod p)，所以 (n+2)^6≡1，故 p|((n+2)^6−1)。
情形三，p|(n−1)。则 n≡1 (mod p)，故 n−2≡−1 (mod p)，从而 (n−2)^6≡1 (mod p)。若 n≥4，则 n−2>1 且 n−2<n，这与 n 的最小性矛盾。因此此情形只能有 n=2 或 n=3；但 n=2 时 p|1 不可能，故 n=3。此时 p|(n−1)=2，故 p=2；而 (n+2)^6−1=5^6−1 为偶数，结论成立。
情形四，p|(n²−n+1)。则 n−1≡n² (mod p)，因此 (n−1)^6≡n^12≡1 (mod p)。若 n≥3，则 1<n−1<n，违反最小性，所以 n=2。此时 p|(2²−2+1)=3，即 p=3，且 (n+2)^6−1=4^6−1=4095 可被3整除。
以上四种情形穷尽所有可能，故断言成立。
